title: Circle Geometry
description:
Given a circle with radius 7, calculate and print its diameter, circumference, and area. Use `pi = 3.14159`. Round all results to 2 decimal places.

**Expected output:**
```
Radius: 7
Diameter: 14
Circumference: 43.98
Area: 153.94
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
radius = 7
pi = 3.14159
